text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly buying after prices fell tied up more cash without preventing further account declines; I should buy only when it fits a planned allocation, not simply because a stock looks cheaper.","Large batches of purchases can leave me overexposed to a few stocks, so I should set position limits and preserve cash for future needs.","A few strong months or a profitable sale do not guarantee lasting success; I should judge progress over time and stay focused on my ten-year apartment goal."]}
